title: Top Soundbars for Better TV Sound (2026)
summary: Tom's Guide and What Hi-Fi? both crown the Sonos Arc Ultra, pick the Sony HT-S100F as the cheap upgrade, and also back the Sony Theatre Bar 7 and Bar 6 and the premium KEF XIO.
method: Picks come from Tom's Guide's best soundbars list (updated Oct 5, 2026) and What Hi-Fi?'s best soundbars guide (updated Jun 19, 2026). Each soundbar here is named by both sites.
assumptions: Prices are what the retailer price boxes on those pages showed on the day we checked and change often, so check the current price on Amazon. Where a price is missing, neither page listed one. The two sites test with different rooms and TVs.

products.name: Sonos Arc Ultra
why: Both sites' top soundbar. Tom's Guide says its Dolby Atmos beats almost anything without separate surround speakers, with clear dialogue. What Hi-Fi? calls the sound clean, precise, spacious and three-dimensional, with deep, tuneful bass from the Sound Motion woofer.
Both note that a full setup gets expensive: Tom's Guide suggests adding a Sonos sub, and What Hi-Fi? says surrounds and a sub can be added later.
specs: About 46 inches wide and 3 inches tall
Dolby Atmos; HDMI eARC, wi-fi, ethernet and Bluetooth
AirPlay 2, Spotify Connect and Tidal Connect
Alexa, Google Assistant and Sonos Voice control
cons: Sonos app can still be buggy
products.best_for: Movie and music fans with a TV of 55 inches or more
products.skip_if: You need extra HDMI inputs or DTS:X
products.amazon_listing: Sonos Arc Ultra Soundbar with Dolby Atmos - Black | 9.1.4 Surround Sound for TV and Music

products.name: Sony HT-S100F
why: Tom's Guide's best under $100 and What Hi-Fi?'s best cheap soundbar, where it is sold as the HT-SF150. Both say it is a clear step up from TV speakers, with clearer dialogue and a wide, balanced sound.
What Hi-Fi? adds that dialogue can sound a little muffled and effects lack punch. Tom's Guide says it can sound tinny at times.
specs: About 35 inches wide and 2.5 inches tall
HDMI ARC, optical, USB and Bluetooth
Dolby Digital and 2-channel LPCM; no Dolby Atmos
Sony S-Force Front Surround processing
cons: Doesn't always turn on with the TV
products.best_for: TVs from 32 to 48 inches when you just want clearer dialogue
products.skip_if: You want Atmos or deep bass
products.amazon_listing: Sony S100F 2.0ch Compact and Slim Soundbar for TV with Bluetooth HTS100F | Bass Reflex Spe

products.name: Sony Bravia Theater Bar 7
why: Tom's Guide's best soundbar for movies: crystal-clear dialogue, immersive 5.1.2 Dolby Atmos and a good included subwoofer for impactful bass. What Hi-Fi? lists the Theatre Bar 7 with its subwoofer as a beautifully balanced package that is hard to fault.
Tom's Guide says music playback is only OK, and the bar is compact, so it suits TVs of about 55 inches or smaller best.
specs: About 37.5 inches wide; 5.1.2 Dolby Atmos
Wireless subwoofer included
Wi-Fi streaming and an app for sound settings
Built-in surround and room calibration
cons: Some very subtle high-frequency detail is lost
products.best_for: Movie watchers who want Atmos with a sub for a mid-range price
products.skip_if: You mainly listen to music or have a very large TV
products.amazon_listing: Sony BRAVIA Theater Bar 7 Soundbar for TV Home Theater with 9 Speakers | Dolby Atmos & DTS

products.name: KEF XIO
why: What Hi-Fi?'s best premium soundbar, with detailed, precise sound, tight bass and Dolby Atmos and DTS:X. It says the XIO can double as a standalone music system. Tom's Guide calls it one of the best-sounding, best-looking and best-built soundbars it has tested.
Tom's Guide kept it off its main list because of the $2,500 price, and found the app experience hit or miss.
specs: About 121 cm (48 inches) wide, 10.5kg
HDMI 2.1 eARC, optical, USB and Bluetooth
Dolby Atmos, DTS:X and MPEG-H
Six Uni-Q MX drivers; Spotify, Tidal, Qobuz and more
cons: Only one HDMI eARC input, no passthrough
products.best_for: Buyers who want the best sound from one bar and have the budget
products.skip_if: You want value or need HDMI passthrough
products.amazon_listing: KEF XIO Soundbar, Dolby Atmos 5.1.2, Slate Black | Dolby Atmos 5.1.2 Sound Bar for Home Th

products.name: Sony Bravia Theatre Bar 6
why: Both sites test it as a solid mid-range Dolby Atmos bar. Tom's Guide says it brings a lot to the table in a compact model with a subwoofer in the box. What Hi-Fi? says it gives room-filling sound and a lot of kit for the money.
Neither calls it the best: Tom's Guide finds it boring-looking, with fewer features like AirPlay and Google Cast than rivals, and What Hi-Fi? says it lacks the subtlety and detail of the top pick.
specs: Compact soundbar with Dolby Atmos
Wireless subwoofer included
Solid sound quality for the price class
No AirPlay or Google Cast, per Tom's Guide
products.best_for: Mid-range buyers who want Atmos and a sub in a compact set
products.skip_if: You want the best detail or smart features, where the Theater Bar 7 does more
products.amazon_listing: Sony BRAVIA Theater Bar 6 3.1.2ch Home Theater Soundbar with Wireless Sub | Dual up-firing
